Motunui Village HutMoanaSailing the ocean for a good feed.Every recipe serves 4.
    StartersMainsSweetsDrinks
    StartersCoconut pirate crusted prawnsPrawns coated in panko and shredded coconut, fried, with sweet chilli lime dipHow to make it500g green prawns, peeled4 tbsp plain flour2 eggs, beaten60g panko breadcrumbs60g shredded coconut1 L vegetable oil, for frying100ml sweet chilli sauce1 lime, juicedSet up a station: flour, beaten egg, then the panko mixed with the coconut.Dip each prawn in flour, egg, then the crumb mix.Fry in the oil at 180°C for 2 minutes, in batches.Serve with sweet chilli sauce mixed with lime juice.Tamatoa's shiny poke cupsDiced tuna in soy and sesame over sushi rice with cucumberHow to make it200g sushi rice300g sashimi tuna, diced2 tbsp soy sauce1 tsp sesame oil2 spring onions, sliced1 red chilli, finely chopped1 Lebanese cucumber, dicedCook the sushi rice and cool.Toss the tuna with soy, sesame oil, spring onion and chilli.Spoon the rice into small cups and top with tuna and cucumber.Motunui taro chips with coconut lime dipThe gardens and groves on MotunuiHow to make itAs written, serves 4Thin taro slices fried crisp and dusted with chilli salt, with a cool dip of coconut yoghurt, lime zest, coriander and a touch of garlic.Peel 600g taro and slice paper thin on a mandoline, then rinse and pat completely dry.Fry in batches in oil at 175°C for 2 to 3 minutes until crisp and pale golden, then drain and toss with salt and a pinch of chilli powder.Mix 250g coconut yoghurt with the zest and juice of a lime, chopped coriander, 1 small grated garlic clove and salt for the dip.MainsTe Fiti fish in coconutSnapper poached in coconut milk with lime leaf, ginger and chilliHow to make it400ml coconut milk3 kaffir lime leaves1 piece ginger, sliced1 red chilli, sliced600g snapper fillets2 limes, juiced2 tbsp chopped coriander300g jasmine riceCook the rice.Simmer the coconut milk with lime leaves, ginger and chilli for 5 minutes.Add the snapper and poach gently for 8 minutes.Finish with lime juice and coriander.Maui's huli huli chickenFit for Maui. You're welcome.How to make itAs written, serves 4Chicken thighs marinated in pineapple, soy, ginger and brown sugar, grilled and basted until sticky and charred, with coconut rice and grilled pineapple.Mix 200ml pineapple juice, 80ml soy sauce, 60g brown sugar, 3 tbsp tomato sauce, 2 tbsp grated ginger and 3 crushed garlic cloves.Marinate 1kg chicken thigh fillets in half for 4 hours and simmer the rest until syrupy for basting.Cook 300g jasmine rice with 270ml coconut milk and 250ml water.Grill the chicken for 5 minutes a side, basting often, with 8 pineapple slices.Serve with the rice and sliced spring onion.SweetsCoconut haupiaSet coconut milk pudding cut into squares, topped with toasted coconutHow to make it800ml coconut milk100g caster sugar60g cornflour30g shredded coconut, toasted2 mangoes, dicedWhisk the coconut milk, sugar and cornflour together in a pot.Stir over medium heat until very thick.Pour into a tray and chill for 3 hours.Cut into squares and top with toasted coconut and diced mango.DrinksCoconut, pineapple and lime crushCoconut water, pineapple, lime and mint blended slushy, served in coconut halvesHow to make it500ml chilled coconut water400g fresh pineapple chunks2 limes, juiced1 handful mint leaves, plus sprigs1 tbsp honey2 cups iceBlend the coconut water, pineapple, lime juice, mint, honey and ice until slushy.Pour into halved coconuts or tall glasses.Garnish with a pineapple wedge and a mint sprig.
